issues.title: Installing the vendored tarball connects to api.ipify.org, ip-api.com and httpbin.org
issues.text: Runtime evidence (Garnet, head 84940b2, compared with the clean constructed install b678bdb): workload destinations +3 from chain node → dash → node: api.ipify.org, ip-api.com, httpbin.org. Nothing in the one-file diff pointed at an install script; the record is the only source for this finding.
